::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 3d 1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin.
:::

Dear Madam

[Aunt Judy’s Magazine](organizations/other_54.qmd) generally has a little play every Christmas. It might be worth while to offer yours

Yours truly
C M Yonge
